quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 40

questions.question: Unless otherwise posted, what is the speed limit on streets and highways?

options.text: 70 mph
55 mph
45 mph
30 mph

questions.correctAnswerText: 55 mph
questions.explanation: The default speed limit is 55 mph on streets and highways. If a sign shows a different speed, follow the posted sign.

questions.question: You see a flashing red light at an intersection. What must you do?

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Turn right or left because the road ahead is blocked.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop completely. After stopping, you may go if the way is clear and it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Do not enter.
No parking.
No U-turn.
No left turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No U-turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: When driving around a curve, what is most important about speed?

options.text: Drive at the posted speed limit as you enter, then slow down at the sharpest part.
Slow down before you enter the curve.
Speed up gently before you enter the curve.
Drive at the posted speed limit before, during, and after the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before you enter the curve.
questions.explanation: Slow down before entering a curve. Your vehicle may be hard to control in a curve. Slowing down first helps you stay in control.

questions.question: When you see an accident, what should you do?

options.text: Keep your attention on your driving.
Keep moving.
Stop only if you are involved or if help has not arrived yet.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Do not stop at an accident unless you are involved or emergency help has not arrived. Stay focused on driving and keep moving. Watch for people on or near the road. Do not drive to an accident just to look.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is green.
A traffic signal is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A traffic signal is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What do regulatory signs do?

options.text: Are placed everywhere there is danger.
Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
Are diamond-shaped and yellow or green.
Warn drivers about school zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular with black text on white. They tell drivers what they must or must not do. They show speed limits, say no passing or no turning, and explain other driving rules.

questions.question: What lights should you use when driving in fog?

options.text: Parking lights.
Low beams.
High beams.
It does not matter which lights you use.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beams.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: What does this yield sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways as you cross.
Always stop completely at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What is a speed restriction sign?

options.text: Can be ignored in rain, snow, or ice.
Has a triangle shape.
Is blue with black letters.
Shows a recommended speed for curves or turns.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shows a recommended speed for curves or turns.
questions.explanation: Curve and turn warning signs show a recommended safe speed. You may drive faster in good weather, but you should slow down in rain, snow, or icy conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a sharp curve in the direction of the arrow. The arrow points left, so the road curves sharply to the left. You may see several of these signs along a curve.

questions.question: When driving near heavy trucks, what must other drivers allow for?

options.text: Large vehicles need more distance to stop.
Large vehicles need less distance to stop.
Large vehicles are quieter.
Large vehicles drive faster.

questions.correctAnswerText: Large vehicles need more distance to stop.
questions.explanation: Heavy trucks need more distance to stop than smaller vehicles. Stay in places where the truck driver can see you. Do not block the truck driver's view of traffic.

questions.question: What is the correct way to use a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: Slow down before entering the exit ramp.
Slow down after you enter the exit ramp.
Keep your speed the same on the exit ramp.
Pass slower traffic on the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down after you enter the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Do not slow down before you enter the exit ramp. Slow down only after you have moved onto the exit ramp.

questions.question: What happens if a bicyclist does not obey traffic laws?

options.text: Bicyclists do not have to obey traffic laws.
They can be ticketed.
They will always get a warning.
Their bicycle will be taken away.

questions.correctAnswerText: They can be ticketed.
questions.explanation: Bicyclists have the same rights, duties, and responsibilities as car drivers. Both car drivers and bicyclists can be ticketed for breaking traffic laws.

questions.question: You are waiting at an intersection to turn left. What should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels to the left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights so drivers will let you through.
Drive around the back of a car that blocks you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning or changing lanes. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn left. If another car hits you from behind, straight wheels keep you out of oncoming traffic.

questions.question: When should you slow down when exiting a highway?

options.text: On the main road, just before the exit lane.
When you see a toll booth.
After you move into the exit lane.
When you first see the exit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: After you move into the exit lane.
questions.explanation: Enter the exit lane well in advance. Do not slow down until after you are on the exit lane.

questions.question: If an oncoming car is heading toward you in your lane, what should you do?

options.text: Honk, steer right, and speed up.
Honk, steer left, and brake.
Honk, steer right, and brake.
Stay in your lane, honk, and brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Honk, steer right, and brake.
questions.explanation: First, honk to get the other driver's attention. If they do not move, steer right. Do not steer left because the other driver might swerve left too, and you will still crash. Brake hard and steady. Each mile per hour slower reduces the crash impact.

questions.question: When crossing railroad tracks with no signals or gates, what must you do?

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You can pass slower drivers while crossing.
Make sure your car can cross all the way without stopping.
All of the above

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your car can cross all the way without stopping.
questions.explanation: Check that you have enough room to cross the tracks completely before you start. Never pass another car at a railroad crossing. Always look for trains before crossing any tracks.

questions.question: What is true about a work zone?

options.text: It can be moving or stationary.
It is marked with black and white signs.
Drivers do not need to slow down.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can be moving or stationary.
questions.explanation: Work zones can be stationary or moving (like vehicles painting lines, mowing, or removing snow). Work zones use orange signs with black letters or symbols. Slow down and pay close attention in work zones.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from either direction.
Passing is allowed from the lane with the broken line.
Passing is allowed from the lane with the solid line.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from the lane with the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means you can pass only from the side with the broken line.

questions.question: To prepare for hazards ahead, you should:

options.text: Look at the entire road and all sides.
Stare straight ahead at all times.
Drive with your left foot resting on the brake pedal.
Focus on the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look at the entire road and all sides.
questions.explanation: You can handle dangerous situations better by spotting problems early. Look ahead of your vehicle, but do not just stare at the center. Look at the entire road, including both sides.

questions.question: In a roundabout, drivers should:

options.text: Yield to traffic entering.
Yield to traffic already in the roundabout.
Drive clockwise.
Stop in the roundabout.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to traffic already in the roundabout.
questions.explanation: A roundabout is a circular intersection with traffic flowing counterclockwise. There is usually no traffic signal. Enter from the right and yield to cars already in the roundabout. Follow the circle right until you reach your exit.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
No left turn.
Merge.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merge.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are about to become one.

questions.question: You can drive in HOV lanes if:

options.text: You are driving faster than other traffic.
You are driving slower than other traffic.
Your vehicle has two or more people.
You need to get somewhere quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your vehicle has two or more people.
questions.explanation: HOV (High Occupancy Vehicle) lanes are for vehicles with two or more people. Some lanes also allow hybrid or low-emission vehicles. These lanes are marked with signs and diamond symbols. You can only enter and exit at marked points.

questions.question: When you double a car's speed, the force of impact increases by:

options.text: Two times.
Three times.
Four times.
Nothing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Four times.
questions.explanation: Faster speeds create greater impact force. Doubling your speed increases impact force by four times.

questions.question: When two vehicles reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time:

options.text: The larger vehicle has the right-of-way.
The car on the left has the right-of-way.
The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
The car on the right must yield to the car on the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the left must yield to the car on the right.
questions.explanation: When two cars arrive at the same time, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. The left driver can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: A single broken yellow line on a two-lane road means:

options.text: Opposite traffic and no passing.
Opposite traffic and passing is allowed when safe.
Same direction traffic and no passing.
Same direction traffic and passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Opposite traffic and passing is allowed when safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken line means you can pass when it is safe.

questions.question: When turning right at a green light, you must:

options.text: Keep your normal speed.
Stop and look for police.
Yield to pedestrians.
Speed up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to pedestrians.
questions.explanation: You may turn right at a green light unless a sign says otherwise. Always yield to other vehicles and pedestrians in the intersection.

questions.question: For a first DUI conviction, penalties can include:

options.text: Only a fine.
A fine and community service.
A fine, community service, and jail time.
A fine, community service, jail time, DUI school, license revocation, and an Ignition Interlock Device.

questions.correctAnswerText: A fine, community service, jail time, DUI school, license revocation, and an Ignition Interlock Device.
questions.explanation: A first DUI conviction can result in a fine, community service, jail time, license revocation, DUI school, and an Ignition Interlock Device. Penalties increase with more convictions.

questions.question: A solid yellow arrow on a traffic signal means:

options.text: It is not used as a traffic signal.
The same as a yellow circular light.
You can turn in the direction shown.
A green arrow is coming next.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same as a yellow circular light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow means the same as a yellow light. Slow down and prepare for a red light.

questions.question: If you injure someone while passing a stopped school bus that is picking up or dropping off children, you will:

options.text: Be fined up to $500.
Be allowed to keep your license.
Be fined $1,500.
Face no legal consequences.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be fined $1,500.
questions.explanation: You must stop completely when you see a school bus with flashing lights. If you pass a stopped school bus and injure someone, you will be fined $1,500. You may also lose your license and be required to do community service.

questions.question: You turn onto a two-lane road with a broken yellow line in the middle. This tells you:

options.text: Traffic moves in both directions on this road.
Traffic moves in only one direction on this road.
The road is being repaired.
You must stay left of the broken yellow lines.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in both directions on this road.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line means you may pass slower traffic when it is safe.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must drive at the exact speed shown.
The highest speed allowed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through intersections at this speed.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest speed allowed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed you can drive on this road. In rain, snow, ice, or bad conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: You see a sign that says "Reduced speed, 35 mph." This means:

options.text: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
The new 35 mph speed limit starts at the next speed limit sign.
You have plenty of time to slow down before the new speed zone.
You should only reduce speed to 35 mph in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: The new 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
questions.explanation: "Reduced speed" signs tell you to slow down. The new speed limit begins right at the sign.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Emergency vehicles ahead.
An intersection with no traffic controls ahead.
A four-way stop ahead.
A traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: The road has a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line down the middle. The broken line is next to your lane. You may pass:

options.text: Only in an emergency.
Only on an expressway.
When the road ahead is clear.
Only at an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: When the road ahead is clear.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to your lane means you can pass if no traffic is coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: How far a vehicle can stop does NOT depend on:

options.text: How fast you react.
What time of day it is.
The condition of your brakes.
The condition and type of your tires.

questions.correctAnswerText: What time of day it is.
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your reaction time, weather, visibility, vehicle weight, brake condition, tire condition and type, road conditions, and speed. The time of day does not affect stopping distance.

questions.question: Lanes with traffic moving in the same direction are divided by ____ lines.

options.text: Yellow
White
Red
Black

questions.correctAnswerText: White
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. A solid white line means do not cross. A broken white line means you can cross to pass. Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Curves ahead.
A divided highway is starting.
A divided highway is ending.
Bumps in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: A divided highway is ending.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: Your vehicle begins to skid. You should:

options.text: Turn the wheel too hard in the opposite direction.
Turn your steering wheel toward oncoming traffic.
Turn your steering wheel in the direction the back of the car is sliding.
Let go of the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel in the direction the back of the car is sliding.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, stay calm and steer toward the direction of the skid.

questions.question: Can you cross a double solid yellow centerline to pass another car?

options.text: Yes.
No.
Only if there is no oncoming traffic.
Only if the car ahead is driving below the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: No.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot cross them. The only exception is turning into or out of a driveway or business entrance. You cannot pass by crossing a solid yellow line.

questions.question: What helps drivers save gasoline?

options.text: Leaving the engine running in the driveway.
Speeding up quickly.
Slowing down gradually.
Braking hard.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slowing down gradually.
questions.explanation: Sudden stops waste fuel because you must accelerate again to get back to speed. When you look ahead and slow down gradually or change lanes to avoid hard braking, you use less gas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
You can only turn in certain directions from certain lanes.
Do not enter.
Drivers in both lanes must merge safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people in them.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are reserved for buses and cars with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: You cannot drive faster than:

options.text: The posted speed limit.
What is reasonable and safe for the situation.
What is safe for current road and weather conditions.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: You must obey the speed limit and drive at a speed that fits the area, traffic, pedestrians, weather, road quality, and light. Your speed must always be safe for the conditions.

questions.question: When a traffic light turns green, what should you do?

options.text: Let pedestrians cross first.
Speed up as fast as you can.
Back up slowly.
Wait for another driver to wave you forward.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let pedestrians cross first.
questions.explanation: A green light means you can go. However, you must first let any traffic or pedestrians still in the intersection pass safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No parking.
Divided highway ahead.
Left turn signal.
Yield.

questions.correctAnswerText: No parking.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: Highway signs that warn about dangerous conditions are called:

options.text: Regulatory signs.
Warning signs.
Information signs.
Guide signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning signs.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to potential hazards ahead. You must obey these signs for your safety. Ignoring them can cause accidents.

questions.question: What is the safe way to drive through a curve?

options.text: Slow down before entering, speed up when exiting.
Keep the same speed throughout the curve.
Speed up before entering, slow down when exiting.
Stay near the right edge of your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before entering, speed up when exiting.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you enter a curve and speed up gradually as you leave it. Speeding into a curve makes your vehicle harder to control.

questions.question: How can you avoid crashes caused by drinking and driving?

options.text: Decide before drinking that you will not drive.
Tell people "No thanks, I'm driving" if they offer you a drink.
Call a taxi.
Do any of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do any of the above.
questions.explanation: The best way to avoid drinking and driving is to decide before you drink that you will not drive. Alcohol affects your judgment, so you cannot make safe choices after you start drinking.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ colored and must always be followed.

options.text: White
Blue
Green
Orange

questions.correctAnswerText: White
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control how traffic moves. They are white with black markings and drivers must always obey them.
